name: Belavia
note: Official partner of HC Dinamo Minsk; Belavia wordmark is on the pants shell of the 2026-27 kits. Propose serious: Belavia is Belarus's state airline (state holds 100% of the shares), and UN-mandated experts found Belarus's repression of critics — arbitrary detention, torture — amounts in part to crimes against humanity.

why.text: Belavia is Belarus's state-owned airline. UN experts found that Belarus's authorities have carried out widespread, systematic repression of critics — arbitrary arrests, torture and persecution — some of it amounting to crimes against humanity, and more than a thousand political prisoners were still behind bars in late 2025. A famous jersey makes the country look good to fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: UN experts found Belarus's repression of critics amounts in part to crimes against humanity, and Belavia is the state airline.
